name: The First Pier
description: The nearer island, where the line comes ashore in the air.
arrival: The track runs out over nothing and then there is ground under it -- grass, low cushion-plant, a stand of aero-mangrove holding the edge together with its roots. Walk to the rim and the rain that is falling on the underside is falling the wrong way.
notes: The first floating island a player stands on, and the map's teaching moment: the inverted water is right there at the rim, and nothing explains it. Canon does -- lodestone cores of Permian-irradiated ore, a legacy of the shattering of Gondwana -- but nobody on this map says so, because nobody on this map knows.
